relationships.relation_statement: Set the number of variables and equations to one, with support equal to the given exponent set. Laurent monomial factors are units on C*, so removing them preserves precisely the recorded nonzero roots.
relationships.evidence_location: The two stored descriptors; direct specialization to one equation on C*.
relationships.inheritance_policy: No automatic inheritance. A result may be transferred only after explicitly checking its hypotheses, parameter specialization, solution convention and genericity.
relationships.caveats: Zero roots of a polynomial are excluded in both problems. Keep generic nonzero extremal coefficients and support-lattice hypotheses when transferring monodromy results.
